Helez the Paltite, Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,

people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

people.name: Helez
people.line: One of David's mighty warriors from Pelet.

people.name: Pelonites
people.line: Designation for two of David's mighty warriors

translations.web: The seventh captain for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
translations.bsb: The seventh, for the seventh month, was Helez the Pelonite, an Ephraimite. There were 24,000 men in his division.
translations.kjv: The seventh captain for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
translations.asv: The seventh captain for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
